spec_basis: STU-LAY-121: Vertical justification enumeration {vjust.top, vjust.center, vjust.bottom, vjust.justify}. Only vjust.justify activates vertical_threshold and vertical_balance_columns.

STU-LAY-118 vertical_threshold: maximum vertical space inserted between two paragraphs; valid only when vertical justification is vjust.justify; ADDS to the paragraph's own space-before/space-after rather than replacing it

STU-TYP-190: A CONTAINER property, not a paragraph property ... When justify_align, vertical_threshold caps the inter-paragraph space the justification may add. vertical_threshold hard_min 0, hard_max UNKNOWN

STU-LAY-160: Ink manager ... ink_angle 0..360 deg, ink_frequency 1..500, neutral_density 0.001..10.0, solidity 0.0..1.0, ink_type {ink.normal, ink.opaque, ink.transparent, ink.opaque_ignore}, per-ink spot-to-process conversion, all-spots-to-process, ink aliasing and use-standard-Lab-values-for-spots. Captured typed error: a process ink cannot be aliased. ... a mixed ink may contain no more than 27 spot inks and no more than 31 inks in total, and a mixed-ink GROUP may contain no more than 1,000 swatches. ... Separations preview -- per-plate on/off preview, an ink-limit view with a configurable total-ink threshold, and per-ink coverage readouts. These MUST be readable as typed values, not only rendered.
STU-COL-212: per-plate visibility toggles ...; an INK LIMIT view ...; and a per-ink percentage-coverage readout at a sampled point ... the engine computes the actual maximum from the active ink set

STU-LAY-250: total_ink_limit 0..400 (scales with ink count), single_ink_limit 0..100, black_ink_limit 0..100, coverage_warning_margin; the three limits are INDEPENDENT ... MUST report a violation as structured data
